English: The coordination polymer [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, (QNX = Quinoxaline; TDPH = 3,3-thiodipropionic acid), has been prepared by reaction of copper acetate, TDPH, and quinoxaline.
Luganda: Coordination polymer [[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, (QNX = Quinoxaline; TDPH = 3,3-thiodipropionic acid), ekoleddwa mu kugatta copper acetate, TDPH, ne quinoxaline.
Yoruba: Kẹ́míkà pólímà aṣàkóso náà [[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, (QNX = kunọsálíì; TDPH = 3,3 ásíìdì todipolíì), ti di pípèsè nípa àbáyọ Iyọ̀ kọ́pa, TDPH, àti kunọsalíì.
Zulu: I-coordination polymer [[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, (QNX = Quinoxaline; TDPH = 3,3-thiodipropionic acid), ilungiswe ngokusabela kwe-copper acetate, i-TDPH, ne-quinoxaline.
Hausa: An shirya folimar daidaitawa [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)] DMF, (QNX = Quinoxaline; TDPH = 3,3-sindarin thiodipropionic), ta hanyar amsawar koren jan ƙarfe mai duhu da TDPH da kuma quinoxaline.
Northern Sotho: Coordination polymer [[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, (QNX = Quinoxaline; TDPH = 3,3-thiodipropionic acid), e beakantšwe ka phetogo ya copper acetate, TDPH, le quinoxaline.
Amharic: የፖሊመር ቅንብሩ [[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF፣ (QNX = ኩዊኖክሳሊን፤ TDPH = 3፣3-ቲዎዲፕሮፒዮኒክ አሲድ)፣ በመዳብ አሲቴት፣ TDPH እና በኩዊኖክሳሊን አፀግብሮት ተዘጋጅቷል።

English: The compound was characterized by elemental analysis, FTIR spectroscopy, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
Luganda: Ekivudde mu kugatta kyalimu elemental analysis, FTIR spectroscopy, ne single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
Yoruba: Àkànpọ̀ náà jẹ ìyàsọ́tọ̀ nípa àwọn ìtúpalẹ̀ ẹ̀yà, ìṣòdiwọ̀n-oníranǹran FTIR, àti ìtúpalẹ̀ aṣàlàyé ìkóónú olódiiidi kan.
Zulu: Inhlanganisela yabonakala ngokuhlaziywa okuyisisekelo, i-FTIR spectroscopy, kanye ne-single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
Hausa: An siffanta da fili ta hanyar binciken tushe, FTIR spectroscopy, da kuma haskawar kiristal-ɗaya na X-ray.
Northern Sotho: Tswakanyo e be e faroganywa ke tshekatsheko ya motheo, spektrosekhopi sa FTIR, le diffraction ya X-rei ya khristale ye e sepelago e le noši.
Amharic: ውሁዱ በንጥረ ነገር ትንተና፣ በFTIR ስፔክትሮስኮፒ እና በነጠላ-ቡረሌ የኤክስሬይ ጥመት ተለይቶ ይታወቃል።

English: The crystal is monoclinic with a P21/n space group and dimensions of a = 12.889(3) Å, b = 14.983(4) Å, c = 14.091(3) Å, α = 90 °, β = 90.200(11) °, γ = 90 °, V = 2721.18 (2) Å3, Z = 4.
Luganda: Akakulungwa kalina obutaffaali bubiri n’ekibinja ky’ebbanga P21/n n’ebipimo bya a = 12.889(3) Å, b = 14.983(4) Å, c = 14.091(3) Å, α = 90 °, β = 90.200(11) °, γ = 90 °, V = 2721.18 (2) Å3, Z = 4.
Zulu: Itshe elikhanya okwengilazi liyi-monoclinic eneqembu lesikhala le-P21/n izilinganiso se-a = 12.889(3) Å, b = 14.983(4) Å, c = 14.091(3) Å, α = 90 °, β = 90.200(11) ° , γ = 90 °, V = 2721.18 (2) Å3, Z = 4.
Hausa: Mai ƙara kuzari shi ne monoclinic tare da rukunin sarari P21/n da girman a = 12.889(3) Å, b = 14.983(4) Å, c = 14.091(3) Å, α = 90 °, β = 90.200(11) ° , γ = 90 °, V = 2721.18 (2) Å3, Z = 4.
Northern Sotho: Khristale ke monokliniki ya sehlopha sa sekgoba sa P21/n le dibopego tša = 12.889(3) Å, b = 14.983(4) Å, c = 14.091(3) Å, α = 90 °, β = 90.200(11) °, γ = 90 °, V = 2721.18 (2) Å3, Z = 4.

English: The ligands are hexagonally coordinated to the Cu(II) centre in the form of Cu2O4N with one nitrogen atom from the quinoxaline ligand, and four oxygen atoms from four TDPH molecules in a monodentate fashion.
Luganda: Ligands zikwasaganyizibwa n’amakkati ga Cu(II) mu ngeri ya Cu2O4N ne atomu ya nitrogen emu okuva mu quinoxaline ligand, ne atomu z’omukka ogussibwa nnya okuva mu molekyu za TDPH nnya mu ndabika ya monodentate.
Yoruba: Àwọn mólékù tí wọ́n so mọ́ ara wọn jẹ́ onígunmẹ́fà tí wọ́n ń sàkóso Cu(II) láàrin ní orí Cu2O4N pẹ̀lú átọ́ọ̀mù náítójíìnì kan láti inú mólékù TDPH kan nínú lígááǹdì olójú-kan.
Zulu: Ama-ligand axhunywe ngendlela ye-hexagon phakathi nendawo ye-Cu(II) ngendlela ye-Cu2O4N ene-nitrogen atom eyodwa esuka ku-quinoxaline ligand, nama-oxygen atom amane avela kuma-TDPH molecule amane ngendlela ye-monodentate.
Hausa: An haɗa haɗin ta kusurwa shida zuwa tsakiyar Cu(II) a cikin nau’i na Cu2O4N tare da atom ɗin nitrogen guda ɗaya daga quinoxaline ligand, da ƙwayoyin oxygen guda huɗu daga ƙwayoyin TDPH guda huɗu a cikin salon monodentat
Northern Sotho: Dilikante di kgokagantšhwa ka sebopego sa heksakone go senthara ya Cu(II) ka sebopego sa Cu2O4N ka atomo ya naeterotšene e tee go tšwa go quinoxaline ligand, le diathomo tše nne tša oksitšene go tšwa go dimolekhule tše nne tša TDPH go sebopego sa monodentate.
Amharic: አጋሪዎቹ በCu(II) መሃል ላይ በCu2O4N ቅርጽ ከኩዊኖክሳሊን አጋሪ ከአንድ ናይትሮጅን አቶም እና ከአራት TDPH ሞለኪዩሎች፣ ከአራት ኦክስጂን አቶሞች ጋር በሞኖዴንቴት መልክ በባለ ስድስት ጎንዮሽ የተቀናጁ ናቸው።

English: The Cu-Cu bond length was 2.642(1) and 2.629(1) Å for the Cu1----Cu1 and Cu2----Cu2 bonds.
Luganda: Obuwanvu bwa bond za Cu-Cu bond bwali 2.642(1) ne 2.629(1) Å obwa bond za Cu1----Cu1 ne Cu2----Cu2.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀n ìdìpọ̀ Cu-Cu náà jẹ́ 2.642(1) àti 2.629(1) Å fún Cu1----Cu1 àti ìdì Cu2----Cu2 náà.
Zulu: Ubude bobudlelwano be-Cu-Cu babungu-2.642(1) kanye no-2.629(1) Å bobudlelwano be-Cu1----Cu1 kanye ne-Cu2----Cu2.
Hausa: Tsawon haɗin Cu-Cu shi ne 2.642(1) da 2.629(1) Å don haɗin Cu1---Cu1 da kuma Cu2----Cu2.
Northern Sotho: Botelele bja bond ya Cu-Cu e be e le 2.642(1) le 2.629(1) Å ya diponte tša Cu1----Cu1 le Cu2----Cu2.
Amharic: የCu-Cu እስስር ርዝመቱ 2.642(1) እና 2.629(1) Å ለCu1----Cu1 እና Cu2----Cu2 እስስሮች ነበር።

English: The QNX ligand bridged the two copper atoms.
Luganda: Ligand ya QNX yagatta atomu z’ekikomo ebbiri.
Yoruba: Lígáàdì QNX náà ṣe àsopọ̀ àwọn kọ́pà átọ́ọ̀mù.
Zulu: I-QNX ligand yahlanganisa ama-atoms amabili ethusi.
Hausa: Ƙarƙashin QNX ya haɗu da atom na tagulla guda biyu.
Northern Sotho: Likante ya QNX e kopantše diathomo tše pedi tša koporo.
Amharic: የQNX አጋሪው ሁለቱን የመዳብ አቶሞች አገናኝቷል።

English: The catalytic reduction of 4-nitrophenol to 4-aminophenol using NaBH4 in the presence of [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, as catalyst was completed within 11 minutes.
Luganda: Okukendeera kwa catalyst eya 4-nitrophenol okutuuka ku 4-aminophenol nga bakozesa NaBH4 nga waliwo [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, nga catalyst kwakomekkerezebwa mu ddakiika 11.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀dínkù èròjà amúṣedánwòyá ti natofẹnọ́ọ̀-4 sí aminofẹ́nọ́ọ̀-4 nípa lílo NaBH4 nínú wíwà [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, bí ìmúṣedánwòyá se di ṣíṣe pé láàrin ìṣẹ́jú 11.
Zulu: Ukuphungulwa kwesilinganisi esingu-4-nitrophenol ku-4-aminophenol kusetshenziswa i-NaBH4 kukhona ne-[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)]].DMF, njengesilinganisi yaqedwa phakathi nemizuzu eli-11.
Hausa: Rage mai ƙara kuzari na 4-nitrophenol zuwa 4-aminophenol ta amfani da NaBH4 a gaban [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)] DMF, kamar yadda aka kammala mai ƙara kuzari a cikin mintuna 11.
Northern Sotho: Phokotšo ya go potlakišwa ga 4-nitrophenol go 4-aminophenol go šomišwa NaBH4 ka go khwetšagalo ya [[Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF, ka ge sepotlakišakhemikhale se phethilwe mo metsotsong ye 11.
Amharic: [Cu2(TDPH)4(QNX)].DMF ባለበት NaBH4 በመጠቀም የ4-ናይትሮፊኖል ወደ 4-አሚኖፊኖል ተንኳሻዊ ርደሳው እንደ ተንኳሽ በ11 ደቂቃዎች ተጠናቋል።

English: The 4-aminophenol product was confirmed using 1H NMR spectroscopy.
Luganda: Ekiva mu 4-aminophenol kyakakasibwa nga bakozesa 1H NMR spectroscopy.
Yoruba: Ohun-èlò aminofẹ́nọ́ọ̀-4 náà ni wọ́n gba ẹ̀rí jẹ́ nípa lílo 1H NMR ìṣòdiwọ̀n-oníranǹran.
Zulu: Umkhiqizo we-4-aminophenol waqinisekiswa kusetshenziswa i-1H NMR spectroscopy.
Hausa: An tabbatar da samfurin 4-aminophenol ne ta amfani da 1H NMR spectroscopy.
Northern Sotho: Setšweletšwa sa 4-aminophenol se tiišeditšwe go šomišwa sepektrosekopi sa 1H NMR.
Amharic: 1H NMR ስፔክትሮስኮፒን በመጠቀም የ4-የአሚኖፊኖል ምርት ተረጋግጧል።

English: Scientists are always looking for new chemicals found in nature, or they create new chemicals and substances in laboratories.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi buli kiseera babeera banoonya ebirungo ebipya ebisangibwa mu butonde, oba batondawo ebirungo ebipya mu magezeserezo.

Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di phela di nyakana le dikhemikhale tše mpsha tše di hwetšwago tlhagong, goba ba hlama dikhemikhale tše mpsha le ditšweletšwa ka dilaporathoring.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች ሁልጊዜም በተፈጥሮ ውስጥ የሚገኙ አዳዲስ ኬሚካሎችን ይፈልጋሉ ወይም አዳዲስ ኬሚካሎችን እና ልይቁሶችን በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ ይፈጥራሉ።

English: These new chemicals can have important uses in medicine, or they can help in certain chemical processes as catalysts.

Northern Sotho: Dikhemikhale tše tše mpsha tše di ka ba le mehola ye bohlokwa, goba di ka thuša go ditshepedišo tše dingwe tša dikhemikhale bjalo ka dipotlakiši.
Amharic: እነዚህ አዳዲስ ኬሚካሎች በህክምና ውስጥ ዋነኛ ጠቀሜታን ሊያገኙ ይችላሉ ወይም ለተወሰኑ የኬሚካል ሂደቶች እንደ ተንኳሽ ሆነው ሊያግዙ ይችላሉ።

English: Researchers from Nigeria, South Africa and Pakistan created a new chemical called a polymer, meaning it was made up of a group of smaller molecules packed together.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza okuva mu, South Africa ne Pakistan baatondawo ekirungo ekipya ekiyitibwa polymer, ekitegeeza nti kyakolebwa mu kibinja kya bumolekyu obutono ennyo nga bugattiddwa wamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí láti ilẹ̀ Nàìjíríà, South Africa àti ilẹ̀ Pakistan ṣẹ̀dá kẹ́míkà tuntun kan tí wọ́n pè ní pólímà, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé ó ṣe àkóónú ọ̀wọ́ àwọn mólékù tí wọ́n kó papọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi base-Nigeria, eNingizimu Afrika nase-Pakistan bakha ikhemikhali entsha ebizwa ngokuthi i-polymer, okusho ukuthi yakhiwe iqembu lamagqamuzana amancane ahlanganiswe ndawonye.
Hausa: Masu bincike daga Nijeriya da Afirka ta Kudu da Pakistan sun ƙirƙiro wani sabon sinadari mai suna folima, ma'ana an yi shi ne da wasu ƙananan ƙwayoyin halitta da aka tattara tare.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši go tšwa Nigeria, Afrika Borwa le Pakistan ba hlamile khemikhale ye mpsha ye e bitšwago polymer, seo se šupago gore e hlamilwe ka sehlopha sa dimolekhule tše nnyane tše di hlophilwego mmogo.
Amharic: ከናይጄሪያ፣ ከደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ከፓኪስታን የተውጣጡ ተመራማሪዎች ፖሊመር የተባለ አዲስ ኬሚካል ፈጥረዋል፤ ይህም ማለት በአንድ ላይ ታጭቀው ከተቀመጡ ትናንሽ ሞለኪዮሎች የተሰራ ማለት ነው።

English: They analysed the structure (shape) and appearance of the polymer, and checked if it could function as a catalyst.
Luganda: Beekenneenya obuzimbe n’endabika ya polymer, ne bakebera okulaba oba esobola okukola nga catalyst.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ ìhun (àwòmọ́) àti ìrísí rẹ̀, wọ́n sì ṣe àyẹ̀wò bóyá ó lè ṣe iṣẹ́ èròjà amúṣedánwòyá.
Zulu: Bahlaziya ukwakheka (umumo) nokubukeka kwe-polymer, futhi bahlola ukuthi ingasebenza yini njengesilinganisi.
Hausa: Sun bincika tsarin (siffa) da bayyanar folima, kuma sun bincika ko zai ta aiki a zaman mai haɓakawa.
Northern Sotho: Ba sekesekile tlhamego (sebopego) le ponagalo tša polymer, le go lekola ge e ba e ka šoma bjalo ka sepotlakišakhemikhale.
Amharic: የፖሊመሩን አወቃቀር (ቅርጽ) እና ገጽታ በመተንተን እንደ ተንኳሽ ሆኖ ሊሰራ ይችል እንደሆነ ፈትሸዋል።

English: They made the new polymer by mixing 3 chemicals known as quinoxaline, thiodipropionic acid and copper(II) acetate, with an alcohol called ethanol, as well as water.
Luganda: Baakola polymer eyo empya nga batabula ebirungo 3 ebiyitibwa quinoxaline, thiodipropionic acid ne copper(II) acetate, n’omwenge oguyitibwa ethanol, awamu n’amazzi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe pólímà tuntun náà nípasẹ̀ ṣíṣe àpòpọ̀ kẹ́míkà 3 tí ó ti wà tẹ́lẹ̀ tí a mọ̀ sí kunọsalíì, ásíìdì todipolíì, àti iyọ̀ kọ́pà (II), pẹ̀lú ọtí ẹtanọ́ọ̀ àti omi.
Zulu: Benza i-polymer entsha ngokuxuba amakhemikhali ama-3 aziwa ngokuthi i-quinoxaline, i-thiodipropionic acid ne-copper(II) acetate, notshwala obubizwa ngokuthi i-ethanol, kanye namanzi.
Hausa: Sun yi sabon folima ne ta hanyar haɗa sinadarai 3 da aka sani da quinoxaline da sinadarin thiodipropionic da kuma copper(II) acetate, tare da sifirit mai suna ethanol da kuma ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlamile polymer ye mpsha ka go tswaka dikhemikhale tše 3 tše di tsebjago ka quinoxaline, thiodipropionic acid le koporo(II) acetate, gammogo le alkoholo ye e bitšwago ethanole, gammogo le meetse.
Amharic: አዲሱን ፖሊመር የሰሩት ኩዊኖክሳሊን፣ ቲዎዲፕሮፒዮኒክ አሲድ እና መዳብ(II) አሲቴት የተባሉትን 3 ኬሚካሎች ውሀን ጨምሮ ኢታኖል ከተባለ አልኮል ጋር በመቀላቀል ነው።

English: Quinoxaline is usually found in treatments for diseases such as cancer and HIV, while thiodipropionic acid is used in the food industry to preserve fats and oils.
Luganda: Quinoxaline atera kusangibwa mu ddagala erijjanjaba endwadde nga kookolo ne HIV, so nga thiodipropionic acid akozesebwa akola ku mmere okukuuma amasavu n’omuzigo.
Yoruba: Lára ìṣèwòsàn fún àrùn jẹjẹrẹ àti HIV ni a ti máa ń rí kúnọsálíì, nígbà tí ásíìdì todipolíì jẹ́ ohun-èlò ohun jíjẹ tí wọ́n fi ń pa ọ̀rá àti epo mọ́.
Zulu: I-Quinoxaline ivamise ukutholakala ekwelapheni izifo ezinjengomdlavuza ne-HIV, kuyilapho i-thiodipropionic acid isetshenziswa embonini yokudla ukuze kugcinwe amanoni namafutha.
Hausa: Ana samun Quinoxaline yawanci a cikin magungunan cututtuka irin su kansa da HIV, yayin da ake amfani da sinadarin thiodipropionic a cikin masana'antar abinci domin adana kitse da kuma mai.
Northern Sotho: Quinoxaline gantši e hwetšagala go dihlare tša malwetši a bjalo ka kankere le HIV, mola esiti ya thiodipropionic e šomišwa go intasteri ya dijo go boloka makhura le dioli.
Amharic: ኩዊኖክሳሊን አብዛኛውን ጊዜ እንደ ካንሰር እና ኤችአይቪ ያሉ በሽታዎችን ለማከም ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል ሲሆን ቲዎዲፕሮፒዮኒክ አሲድ ደግሞ በምግብ ኢንዱስትሪ ውስጥ ስብ እና ዘይቶችን ጠብቆ ለማቆየት ያገለግላል።

English: Copper(II) acetate looks like dark blue or green crystals, and is often used to make other chemicals and catalysts, or to kill pests on farms.
Luganda: Copper(II) acetate afaanana ng’obukulungwa obwa bbulu omukwafu oba kiragala, era atera okukozesebwa okukola ebirungo ne catalyst endala, oba okutta ebiwuka ku malundiro.
Yoruba: Iyọ̀ kọ́pa (II) jọ aláwọ̀ aró dúdú tàbí èròjà amúṣedánwòyá aláwọ̀ ewé, wọ́n sì máa ń sáábà lò ó láti ṣe àwọn kẹ́míkà mìíràn àti èròjà amúṣedánwòyá, tàbí láti pa kòkòrò nínú oko.
Zulu: I-Copper(II) acetate ibukeka njengezinhlayiya ezihlaza okwesibhakabhaka okumnyama noma aluhlaza, futhi ivame ukusetshenziselwa ukwenza amanye amakhemikhali nezilinganisi, noma ukubulala izinambuzane emapulazini.
Hausa: Copper(II) acetate yana kama da lu'ulu'u masu launin shuɗi ko kore, kuma sau da yawa ana amfani da su domin yin wasu sinadarai da masu ƙara kuzari, ko kashe ƙwari a gonaki.
Northern Sotho: Copper(II) acetate e lebelelega bjalo ka dikhresitale tše talaleratadima la boswana goba tše talamorogo, le gona gantši e šomišwa go dira dikhemikhale le dipotlakiši tše dingwe, go bolaya dikhunkhwane dipolaseng.
Amharic: መዳብ አሲቴት ጥቁር ሰማያዊ ወይም አረንጓዴ ቡረሌዎችን የሚመስል ሲሆን አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ሌሎች ኬሚካሎችን እና ተንኳሾችን ለመስራት እንዲሁም በእርሻዎች ላይ ያሉ ተባዮችን ለመግደል ያገለግላል።

English: The researchers successfully showed that their complex molecule can easily be created in the laboratory without too many steps or other substances, and by using laboratory glassware.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga nti molekyu yaabwe engatte nnyangu ya kukola mu ggezeserezo awatali mitendera mingi nnyo oba ebikozesebwa ebirala, n’okukozesesa obugiraasi bw’omu ggezeserezo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣe àṣeyọrí nípa fífi hàn pé mólékù alákànpọ̀ wọn jẹ́ ohun tí ìṣẹ̀dá rẹ̀ nínú láàbù lè rọrùn láìlo ìgbésẹ̀ tó pọ̀ tàbí àwọn èròjà mìíràn, àti nípa lílo àwọn ohun-èlò iṣẹ́ ìwádìí sáyẹ́ńsì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babonise ngempumelelo ukuthi igqamuzana labo elinkimbinkimbi lingenziwa kalula elabhorethri ngaphandle kwezinyathelo eziningi noma ezinye izinto, futhi ngokusebenzisa ingilazi yaselabhorethri.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nasarar nuna cewa za a iya samar da haɗaɗɗen ƙwayoyin halittarsu cikin sauƙi a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje ba tare da yawan matakai ko wasu abubuwa ba, da kuma amfani da kayan gilashin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bontšhitše ka katlego gore molekhule wa bona wo o hlakahlakanego o ka hlangwa gabonolo ka laporathoring ntle le magato a mantši kudu goba ditšweletšwa tše dingwe, le ka go šomiša setšweletšwa sa galase sa laporathori.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ውስብስብ የሆኑት ሞሊኪዮሎቻቸው በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ፣ ያለ ብዙ እርምጃዎች ወይም ሌሎች ልይቁሶች የላብራቶሪ የብርጭቆ እቃዎችን በመጠቀም በቀላሉ ሊሰሩ እንደሚችሉ በተሳካ ሁኔታ አሳይተዋል።

English: They tested the structure of the new molecule using various instruments, including a spectrophotometer, which can identify a substance based on the light it releases or absorbs.
Luganda: Baakebera obuzimbe bwa molekyu empya nga bakozesa ebyuma eby’enjawulo, omuli spectrophotometer, ekisobola okumanya ekirungo okusinziira ku kitangaala kye kifulumya oba kye kiyingiza.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìhun mólékù tuntun náà nípa lílo onírúnrú ohun-èlò, lára wọn ni ohun-èlò ìṣòdiwọ̀n ìrinlẹ̀ ìtànṣán, èyí tí ó lè rí àwọn èròjà nípa wíwo iye ìmọ́lẹ̀ tí ó ń tara rẹ̀ jáde tàbí tí ó ń gbà sára.
Zulu: Bahlole ukwakheka kwegqamuzana elisha besebenzisa amathuluzi ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-spectrophotometer, ekwazi ukuhlonza into ngokukhanya ekukhiphayo noma ekumuncayo.
Hausa: Sun gwada tsarin sabuwa ƙwayar halittar ta hanyar amfani da kayan aiki daban-daban, ciki har da na’urar ɗaukar hoto, wadda za ta iya gano wani abu dangane da hasken da yake fitarwa ko sha.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile diteko tša sebopego sa molekhule o moswa ka tšhomišo ya didirišwa tša go fapafapana, go akaretša sepektrofotometha, yeo e ka hlaolago setšweletšwa go lebeletšwe seetša se e se lokollago goba e se amogelago.
Amharic: በሚለቀው ወይም በሚመጠው ብርሃን ላይ በመመስረት ልይቁስን የሚለየውን ስፔክትሮፎቶሜትርን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ መሳሪያዎችን በመጠቀም የአዲሱን ሞለኪዩል አወቃቀር ፈትሸዋል።

English: Information that comes from a spectrophotometer works like a unique barcode, which is assigned to each chemical in the universe so that scientists can confirm the identities and properties of different substances.
Luganda: Obubaka obuva mu spectrophotometer bukola nga koodi ey’enjawulo, eweebwa buli kirungo mu nsi bannassaayansi ne basobola okukakasa obufaanane n’obukole bw’ebirungo eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn àlàyé tí ó tara ohun-èlò ìṣòdiwọ̀n ìrinlẹ̀ ìtànṣán jáde máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bíi kóòdù kọ̀mpútà àrà ọ̀tọ̀, èyí tí wọ́n so mọ́ kẹ́míkà kọ̀ọ̀kan lágbàáyé kí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì lè fìdí ìdánimọ̀ àti àkóónú onírúnrú èròjà múlẹ̀.
Zulu: Ulwazi oluvela ku-spectrophotometer lusebenza njengebhakhodi ehlukile, enikezwa ikhemikhali ngayinye emhlabeni wonke ukuze ososayensi bakwazi ukuqinisekisa ubunikazi nezici zezinto ezihlukahlukene.
Hausa: Bayanin da yake fitowa daga na'urar spectrophotometer yana aiki kamar lambar sirri ta musamman, wadda aka sanya wa kowane sinadari a sararin samaniya don masana kimiyya su tabbatar da ganewa da kadarorin abubuwa daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo yeo e tšwago go sepektrofotometha e šoma go swana le paakhoute ya moswananoši, yeo e fiwago go khemikhale ye nngwe ye nngwe le ye nngwe gore ditsebi tša saentshe di tiišetša gore ditlhaolwa le dibopego tša ditšweletšwa tša go fapafapana.
Amharic: ከስፔክትሮፎቶሜትር የሚገኘው መረጃ እንደ ልዩ ባርኮድ የሚሰራ ሲሆን ሳይንቲስቶች የተለያዩ ልይቁሶችን ምንነት እና ባህሪያት ለማረጋገጥ ይችሉ ዘንድ በጽንፈ አለሙ ለሚገኙ ኬሚካሎች ሁሉ የሚወስን ነው።

English: The researchers said their polymer is very tiny, measuring only 2.6 nanometers, and has very tiny pores.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti polymer yaabwe ntono nnyo, ng’empima nanometers 2.6 zokka, era erina obutuli butono nnyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé pólímà náà kéré gan-an ni, pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀n nánómítà 2.6, ó sì ní àwọn ojú ihò tí ó kéré gan-an.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi i-polymer yabo incane kakhulu, ikala ama-nanometer angu-2.6 kuphela, futhi inezimbotshana ezincane kakhulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce folima ɗin nasu ɗan ƙanƙani ne, wanda ya kai nanometer 2.6 kacal, kuma yana da ƙananan hudoji.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore polymer tša bona ke tše nnyane kudu, tše di lekanago le dinanometha tše 2.6 fela, le gore di na le mašobana a mannyane kudu.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የእነርሱ ፖሊመር በጣም ትንሽ፣ ልኬቱ 2.6 ናኖ ሜትሮች ብቻ የሆነ እና በጣም ትንሽ ቀዳዳዎች ያሉት እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል።

English: It is shaped a bit like a hexagon, and similar to the paddle wheel of a boat.
Luganda: Yakulamu ng’ekintu eky’ensonga omukaaga, era yeefaanaanyirizaamu enziga y’eryato.
Yoruba: Ó ní àwòmọ́ ẹ̀yà onígunmẹ́fà, ó sì jọ àjẹ̀ ọkọ ojú omi.
Zulu: Yakheke kancane njenge-hexagon, futhi ifana nesondo lokugwedla lesikebhe.
Hausa: An siffata shi da mai ɗan kama da kusurwa shiga, kuma ya yi kama da fedar wilin jirgin ruwa.
Northern Sotho: E bopegile go swana le heksakone gannyane, le go swana le leotwanakhuduo la seketswana.
Amharic: ቅርጹ ትንሽ እንደ ባለ ስድስት ጎን የሚመስል ሲሆን የጀልባ መቅዘፊያ መንኮራኩርንም ይመስላል።

English: They also found that the new molecule could speed up a chemical reaction, so they confirmed that it works as a catalyst.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti molekyu eno empya esobola okwanguya okutabula kw’ebirungo, noolwekyo baakakasa nti ekola nga catalyst.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì tún rí i pé mólékù tuntun náà lè mú kí àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà yá kíá, èyí ni wọ́n fi fìdí ọ̀rọ̀ múlẹ̀ pé ó lè ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí èròjà amúṣedánwòyá.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi igqamuzana elisha lingasheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali, ngakho baqinisekisa ukuthi isebenza njengesilinganisi.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa sabuwar ƙwayar cutar tana iya hanzarta amsawar sindari, don haka sun tabbatar da cewa tana aiki a matsayin mai ƙara kuzari.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le gore molekhule o moswa o ka potlakiša phetogo ya khemikhale, ka gona ba tiišeditše gore e šoma bjalo ka sepotlakišakhemikhale.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም አዲሱ ሞሊኪዩል ኬሚካላዊ አፀግብሮትን ሊያፋጥን እንደሚችል ደርሰውበታል ስለዚህም እንደ ተንኳሽ ሆኖ እንደሚሰራ አረጋግጠዋል።

English: The reaction they chose for the polymer to catalyse was the conversion of a substance called 4-nitrophenol to 4-aminophenol.
Luganda: Okutabula kwe baalondawo polymer eno ekwanguyeeko kwali okukyusa ekirungo ekiyitibwa 4-nitrophenol okukifuula 4-aminophenol.
Yoruba: Àbáyọ tí wọ́n yàn fún pólímà náà láti ṣe iṣẹ́ amúṣedánwòyá ni àyípadà èròjà tí wọ́n pè ní 4-nitofẹ́nọ́ọ̀ sí 4-animofẹ́nọ́ọ̀.
Zulu: Ukusabela abakukhethile ukuze i-polymer isebenze kwaba ukuguqulwa kwento ebizwa ngokuthi i-4-nitrophenol ibe yi-4-aminophenol.
Hausa: Amsawar da suka zaɓa don folima dominn haɓakawa shi ne sauya wani abu mai suna 4-nitrophenol zuwa 4-aminophenol.
Northern Sotho: Phetogo ye ba e kgethetšego polymer go potlakiša e be e le phetošo ya setšweletšwa se se bitšwago 4-nitrophenol go 4-aminophenol.
Amharic: ፖሊመሩ እንዲተነኩሰው የመረጡት አፀግብሮት 4-ናይትሮፌኖል የተባለውን ልይቁስ ወደ 4-አሚኖፌኖል መለወጥን ነበር።

English: A chemical reaction where the substance gains electrons is known as a “reduction reaction”, so scientists refer to the particular reaction that this polymer catalysed as the “catalytic reduction of  4-nitrophenol to 4-aminophenol”.
Luganda: Okutabula kw’ebirungo ekirungo mwe kifunira electrons kuyitibwa “okutabula okw’okukendeeza”, noolwekyo bannassaayansi okutabula polymer eno kwe yayanguya bakuyita “catalytic reduction of 4-nitrophenol to 4-aminophenol”.
Yoruba: Àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà níbi tí ohun-ìlò ti gba agbára iná ni a mọ̀ sí “ẹ̀dínkù àbáyọ”, ni àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ṣe ń pè àbáyọ yìí tí pólímà sọ di amúṣedánwòyá pàtó ní “ẹ̀dínkù ajẹmámúṣedánwòyá ti 4-nitofẹ́nọ́ọ̀ sí 4-animofẹ́nọ́ọ̀”.
Zulu: Ukusabela kwamakhemikhali lapho into izuza ama-electron kwaziwa ngokuthi "ukusabela kokunciphisa", ngakho ososayensi babhekisa ekuphenduleni okuthile le-polymer eyasungulwa njengokuthi "ukuncipha kwesilinganisi se-4-nitrophenol kuya ku-4-aminophenol".
Hausa: Amsawar sinadarai inda abu ya sami ilakturan an san shi da “raguwar amsawa”, don haka masana kimiyya suna yin la'akari da yanayin musamman wanda wannan folima ya haifar da "rage raguwar 4-nitrophenol zuwa 4-aminophenol".
Northern Sotho: Phetogo ya khemikhale moo setšweletšwa se hwetšago dielektrone se tsebja bjalo ka “phokotšo ya phetogo”, ka gona ditsebi tša mahlale di bona go phetogo ye e itšego yeo polymer ye e potlakišitšwego bjalo ka “phokotšo ya potlakišo ya 4-nitrophenol go 4-aminophenol”.
Amharic: ልይቁስ ኤሌክትሮኖችን የሚያገኝበት ኬሚካላዊ አፀግብሮት “የርደሳ አፀግብሮት” ሲባል ይህ ፖሊመር የተነኮሰውን ልዩ አፀግብሮት ሳይንቲስቶች እንደ “የ4-ናይትሮፌኖል ወደ 4-አሚኖፌኖል ተንኳሻዊ ርደሳ” በማለት ይጠቅሱታል።

English: The researchers said their polymer was the first of its kind made from quinoxaline and thiodipropionic acid.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti polymer yaabwe ye yasooka mu kika kino okukolebwa mu quinoxaline ne thiodipropionic acid.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé pólímà tàwọn jẹ́ àkọ́kọ́ irú ẹ̀ tí wọ́n fi ásíìdì kuinosalíì àti todipolíì ṣe.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi i-polymer yabo ingeyokuqala yohlobo lwayo eyenziwe nge-quinoxaline ne-thiodipropionic acid.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce folima ɗinsu shi ne irinsa na farko da aka yi daga quinoxaline da kuma sinadarin thiodipropionic.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore polymer e bile ya mathomo ya moswananoši ye e dirilwego ka esiti ya quinoxaline le thiodipropionic.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከኩዊኖክሳሊን እና ከቲዎዲፕሮፒዮኒክ አሲድ የተሰራው የእነርሱ ፖሊመር በአይነቱ የመጀመሪያው እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ።
